title.suggested: Tom Allen to spar Tom Kelly at Union Grounds tournament

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican printed the programme for a July 4 tournament at Union Base Ball Grounds, closing with a sparring wind-up between Tom Allen, ex-champion of the world, and Tom Kelly for the Union Club Cup.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Wednesday Morning, June 25, 1884, p. 5; Missouri Republican until 1888

facts.fact: Allen was billed to spar the wind-up with Tom Kelly, ex-middleweight champion, at the Union Club's Fourth of July tournament, both in full ring costume, for the Union Club Cup
places: Union Base Ball Grounds, St. Louis

notes: Same advertisement as 709 (Globe-Democrat, same day). Crop could be tightened to the SPORTS ad.
